worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.summary: Hurl a sheet of sand to the target's feet and the ground collapses into quicksand: a grounded target is pinned, drawn toward the pit's centre and pulled downward while grit grinds it, leaving a patch of sanded ground behind. Only rising above the pit escapes - a jump, flight, being lifted or a teleport slips free. The deep style digs deeper and lasts longer and pulls tighter but grinds softer; the snare style grinds harder, pulls looser and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.0: Drag a heavy grounded target down into the pit
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.1: Deny a patch of ground so foes cannot stand there
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.2: Wear down a bulky target with physical damage over time
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.3: Make jumping or flying the foe's only choice
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.0: The grit strikes for about %1$s physical damage and collapses the quicksand pit at the target's feet.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.1: The pit lasts %1$s; a grounded target inside is pinned and cannot walk. It grinds every %2$s for about %3$s physical damage; each beat draws the target %4$s blocks toward the centre and %5$s blocks downward (sinking caps at 0.5 blocks).
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.2: Slipping past %1$s blocks from the centre or rising above the pit (jumping, flying, being lifted, teleporting) breaks free; pit radius %2$s blocks; range %3$s blocks, grit speed %4$s blocks per tick and it homes toward the target.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.on: Deep style on: sink x1.4, duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.15, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - a deeper pit buries the target longer.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.off: Deep style off (snare): less sinking and shorter duration, smaller radius, looser pull and shorter cooldown, but full grind - it ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.growth.0: At level %1$s the grind power rises to %2$s and the pull strength to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.de: On: sink x1.4, duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.15, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - a deeper pit buries the target longer. Off: grinds harder, pulls looser and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.ai: Only consider quicksand on a threat within this distance; lower it to collapse a pit only up close, raise it to trap from farther away.
On: only collapse a pit under a grounded threat and skip airborne foes (no quicksand there, saving the cast); off: willing to try on any threat in range, and an airborne foe will be missed.
